tips: Configuration and cache use persistent Proxmox volumes by default; media defaults to a shared host directory.
Hardware tone mapping is configured persistently after first start when VA-API or NVIDIA is selected.
DLNA multicast behavior depends on the selected Proxmox bridge and firewall.

tagline.en_US: Jellyfin is a media system designed to organize and stream media collections.

description.en_US: Jellyfin is a media system designed to organize and stream media collections. It serves content from a dedicated server to end-user devices across multiple client applications and web interfaces. The platform provides complete control over personal video and audio libraries without relying on proprietary alternatives.
